title: Humanoid Robot Arm
description: Multi-joint arm structure for a consumer humanoid platform.
highlights: Designed a multi-joint mechanical robot arm for a consumer humanoid robot in SOLIDWORKS, optimizing the structure for manufacturability, assembly, and aesthetic integration.

title: Controller Enclosure
description: Serviceable controller housing designed around display, PCB, and cable routing constraints.
highlights: Designed and 3D-printed a controller enclosure with an integrated display opening, PCB mounting standoffs, and cable routing features to support reliable assembly and maintenance.

title: Pipeline Inspection Crawler
description: Full outer enclosure for a pipeline inspection crawler, concept through functional prototype.
highlights: Designed and additively manufactured the complete outer enclosure for a pipeline inspection crawler robot in SOLIDWORKS, taking the design from concept through functional prototype.
Engineered a vented gas sensor housing incorporating an ePTFE membrane, enabling gas diffusion while protecting internal electronics from water splashes and particulate ingress.

title: Autonomous Indoor Thermal Inspection Robot
description: ROS 2 inspection robot fusing LiDAR, RGB, and thermal sensing with a multimodal AI perception stack.
highlights: Built an autonomous indoor inspection robot on a ROS 2 Humble stack using SLAM Toolbox, frontier-based exploration, and LiDAR + monocular RGB + MLX90640 thermal sensors for non-contact anomaly detection (>35°C).

Developed a three-layer perception pipeline (thermal hotspot detection, YOLO11s object detection, and Google Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal analysis) running on a Raspberry Pi 5 mecanum-drive platform, with a distributed Pi/laptop architecture via rosbridge.

Created a natural-language AI chat interface (Gemini 2.5 Flash) letting operators query robot state and issue navigation commands in plain English; built a single-file React operator dashboard with live SLAM map, camera feeds, and thermal overlay.

title: Mini Pupper Quadruped — ROS 2 Jazzy Migration
description: Migrated an open-source quadruped robot stack to ROS 2 Jazzy and Gazebo Harmonic.
highlights: Migrated Mini Pupper ROS quadruped robot stack from ROS 2 Humble to Jazzy, including full Gazebo Classic → Gazebo Harmonic simulator migration (URDF sensor plugins, ros_gz_bridge, gz_ros2_control), Nav2 parameter updates, and Ubuntu 22.04 → 24.04 platform support

Rewrote the champ quadruped contact sensor node from Gazebo Classic C++ transport APIs (gazebo::transport) to Gz Harmonic (gz::transport), enabling foot contact detection in the new simulator for gait controller feedback

Validated end-to-end simulation and real robot deployment, including SLAM (Cartographer/SLAM Toolbox), autonomous navigation (Nav2), teleop control, and automated install scripts for both PC and Raspberry Pi targets.

title: Autonomous Shooting System
description: Vision-guided 2-axis gimbal with PID tracking and trajectory compensation.
highlights: Developed autonomous target shooting system using Python and OpenCV on Raspberry Pi for real-time green LED detection and engagement with 90% accuracy under variable lighting.
Implemented PID control algorithm with position smoothing and dead zone compensation for 2-axis servo gimbal, achieving stable tracking with minimal oscillation.
Integrated trajectory compensation using fixed offset calibration and multi-method HSV colour detection (3 parallel algorithms) for robust target acquisition at 100cm distance.
Designed firing control system with GPIO motor control and automated target sequencing.

title: AI Multi-Model Object Detection System
description: YOLOv11n detection combined with HSV colour classification for bottle sorting.
highlights: Developed and trained a YOLOv11n object detection model to identify beverage bottles with 90-94% confidence using a custom dataset of 100+ labeled images.
Engineered a multi-model AI system integrating YOLO with an HSV-based color classification algorithm to detect and categorize bottles by cap color (yellow vs. white/clear) with 82-99% accuracy.
Implemented end-to-end machine learning pipeline including data collection, annotation using Roboflow, model training with PyTorch, and real-time inference deployment.
Optimized color detection algorithm to analyze specific object regions (cap area) for enhanced classification performance while maintaining minimal processing overhead.

title: Automated Trolley
description: Built a remote-controlled platform capable of carrying a payload of up to 50 kg.
highlights: Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team in the successful development of a practical, automated trolley solution for industrial and manufacturing applications.
Employed SOLIDWORKS for the initial design phase of the automated trolley, ensuring precision and efficiency in the development process.
Addressed challenges in loading/unloading mechanisms, straight-line movement, and 90° turns, showcasing a practical understanding of engineering applications.

title: Motorbike Dolly for Crash Testing
org: Thai German Graduate School of Engineering (TGGS)
description: Design of a motorbike dolly for crash testing with comprehensive engineering analysis.
highlights: Designed a motorbike crash-test dolly in SOLIDWORKS, developing the full design from initial concept sketches through to production-ready mechanical assemblies.
Performed iterative Finite Element Analysis (FEA) under simulated crash loading conditions, optimizing geometry to meet target safety factors while minimizing material usage.
Engineered an energy-absorbing crash cushion system, reducing peak impact forces on test equipment and improving repeatability of crash test results.

title: Consumer Product Design
description: Professional product design role focusing on consumer products from concept to production.
highlights: Conceptualized and sketched initial design concepts, considering user preferences and market trends
Utilized CAD software to create detailed 3D models and prototypes
Successfully brought the designs from concept to production, including Seed Frame products

title: Technical Drawings & 2D Design
description: Professional technical drawings and 2D design work created using AutoCAD.
highlights: Created detailed technical drawings with precise dimensions and annotations
Developed comprehensive 2D design layouts for various engineering applications
Utilized AutoCAD's advanced drafting tools for professional documentation

title: Cleaning Device for Elderly People
description: Designed an accessible cleaning device specifically for the elderly population of Hong Kong.
highlights: Conducted research with a team of seven to develop a user-friendly cleaning device for elderly residents in Hong Kong.
Utilized design tools including functional decomposition diagrams, mind maps, and concept sketches for ideation.
Developed a SOLIDWORKS prototype incorporating product architecture, component selection, and material optimization.
Presented the accessibility, ease of use, and effectiveness of the cleaning device to an audience.

title: Rehabilitation Glove for Tremor Patients
description: Rehab glove using slider tendon actuators and a magnetic vibration absorber.
highlights: Led a team in designing a rehab glove with slider tendon actuators and a magnetic vibration absorber for physical therapy.
Incorporated haptic sensors for enhanced grip strength, allowing patients to lift heavy objects based on muscle movements.
Implemented a vibration absorber with magnetic field generation for stabilizing limbs affected by tremors.
Presented innovative rehab gloves, showcasing strong communication skills and effectively highlighting product features.

title: Table Fan Redesign
description: Comprehensive redesign and optimization of a table fan with focus on performance and manufacturability.
highlights: Collaborated with a team of seven people to analyze and redesign table fan components for improved performance and manufacturability, based on analysis and market research.
Employed hand-drawn sketches and CAD models in SOLIDWORKS for detailed prototyping and stress simulation.
Assembled all components of the original fan in SOLIDWORKS, allowing for a comprehensive view of the product.

title: 3D Vector Calculation Program in Python
description: Object-oriented Python application for 3D vector mathematics with authenticated access.
highlights: Created a Python app for 3D vector calculations with object-oriented design.
Implemented secure login requiring username-password authentication, allowing three attempts before shutdown.
Designed a text menu interface for easy input of 3D vectors, enabling calculations like dot products and arctan, with a convenient application termination option.

title: Teaching Machine Learning & AI Recognition to Children
description: Taught machine learning and programming to high school students in South Africa.
highlights: Educated high school students in South Africa on Machine Learning and Computer Programming through Zoom.
Guided students in applying AI recognition to aid the visually impaired, utilizing Scratch and Google's Teachable Machine to build an Object Recognition System.

title: Gripper Design with Water Bottle
description: Designed a mechanical gripper system for bottle handling with detailed CAD modeling.
highlights: Created a volume-defined bottle design using SOLIDWORKS.
Enhanced gripper for efficient bottle grasping, employing mechanical design principles.
Generated renderings with varied appearances and utilized image mapping and animation videos to showcase the bottle's gripping mechanism.
Produced precise 2D drawings of components with title blocks and annotations.

title: Robot Arm Assembly
description: Designed and developed a six degrees of freedom robot arm using SOLIDWORKS.
highlights: Designed and developed six degrees of Freedom Robot Arm using SOLIDWORKS.
Designed the Cover, Base, Shoulder Support, Upper Arm Model, Power Cable, and the Server Motor Subassembly.
Assembled all the created parts along with the predesigned parts to create the Robot Arm.
